title: Receive reunion without forgetting the Doer
summary: Let quiet trust loosen the hand before it grips again. Let this stay near the next choice: carry this with you: learn to receive under the Lord's pleasure rather than argue with it.
takeaway: Return to Hukam before the self starts arguing again.
lifeApplication: Before arguing with the moment again, stop, name what is already here, and let one resistance fall away.

source.shortMeaning: Reunion is received under the Lord's pleasure and the Creator's doing.
source.lifeApplication: When reunion comes, receive it under the Lord's pleasure before claiming it.
